entities.summary: Mussa Bin Bique, other names Musa Al Big, Mossa Al Bique, Mussa Ben Mbiki or Mussa Ibn Malik, was ruler of the Island of Mozambique and wealthy Omani merchant, before the Portuguese took over the island in 1544.
